card.line: Michmash was a town of Benjamin on the road to Jerusalem, where the Philistines camped and where Israel won a great victory over them.

moments.title: Philistines camp at Michmash
moments.text: The Philistines gathered a huge army with chariots, horsemen, and troops as many as the sand on the seashore. They camped at Michmash, and the men of Israel hid in fear.

moments.title: Jonathan crosses the pass
moments.text: Jonathan and his armor-bearer went toward the Philistine outpost at the pass between two cliffs. Jonathan said nothing can hinder the LORD from saving, whether by many or by few.

moments.title: Israel strikes the Philistines
moments.text: Israel struck down the Philistines all the way from Michmash to Aijalon. By the end of that day the people were very faint.
